answer: Bounded invitation supply resists sybils: new identities enter only through invites, and each account issues just a few per epoch — a scarce juniper seed, not a free fountain. Mass fakery then needs a real tree of inviters, and misbehavior echoes back up it: if an invitee is caught cheating, the sponsoring vertex loses standing too. Sponsors therefore gate who they admit, so a swarm cannot self-manufacture a million entries from one seat.
